name: Lumen H1
summary: Lumen H1 is HECBOT’s humanoid robot for customer reception, exhibition explanation, shopping guidance and business enquiries. Its two arms, hands and bipedal body support human-facing interaction, with voice models, custom knowledge bases, obstacle avoidance and remote operation from a controller, phone or computer. The company describes a replaceable battery and support station for transport, standby and charging. Its official history identifies the July 2025 release as a mass-production launch; current purchasing terms have not been verified.
